title: Introduce interaction thermostat and compact breakpoint profiles for large table views
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: Our virtualized table component currently exposes separate knobs for density (compact/regular/loose), column resizing, and sort/filter controls. Customers building admin consoles juggle viewport size, keyboard-first interactions, and discoverability.

Goal: Ship a cohesive UX layer — the "interaction thermostat" — that dynamically surfaces an appropriate density profile and affordances based on viewport breakpoints, explicit user intent (manual density toggle or persistent preference), and interaction signals (dragging a resize rail, initiating column re-order). Alongside this, deliver a compact breakpoint profile set and keyboard-first resizing behavior that reduces layout thrash for virtualized rows and keeps token alignment predictable across themes.

Scope: Design tokens alignment (spacing, hit areas), new compact breakpoint presets, resize affordance improvements (snap lines, anchoring), keyboard accessibility flows, and acceptance gating for engineering performance constraints (re-render budget per keystroke).
acceptance_criteria: Provide 3 breakpoint-driven density profiles (compact-narrow, compact-wide, regular) with token mappings; each profile documented in tokens table
Resize rail shows snap targets at common widths and keyboard resizing increments of 8px; resizing does not cause full virtualization re-render more than once per 100ms in demo harness
Sort and filter controls remain discoverable in compact modes (secondary condensed toolbar + contextual column menu), tested with keyboard-only and screen reader flows
Design spec includes migration notes for existing tables and a toggle to persist user preference in localStorage (or account setting stub), with fallbacks when JS disabled
Prototype validated in user sessions (3 PMs, 5 engineers, 6 end-users) and major UX issues addressed in follow-ups
engineering_notes: ENG constraints: virtualization rehydration is expensive; prefer column-width-only recalculation rather than full row remounts
Suggest implementing keyboard resize debounce (100ms) and incremental step size configurable by token (spacing-scale-2 = 8px)
Need an API for persistent user density preference: /user-settings.density with fallback to client localStorage
Edge cases: pinned columns + frozen headers must keep position during compact collapse; verify with dedicated rendering tests
Perf telemetry: baseline frames-per-interaction and re-render counts in Storybook harness before and after changes
decisions: Use token-driven spacing scale for density mapping instead of hardcoded px values to support theme parity
Implement thermostat as client-side heuristic + explicit user toggle; server-side rendering will default to 'regular' for safety
Keyboard resizing increments standardized to 8px (token spacing-scale-2) with modifier keys for 32px jumps
Keep sort/filter affordances visible via a condensed toolbar in compact modes rather than burying them in a global menu to improve discoverability
